model_claims.text: Evaluating every rotation condition prevents a skipped condition from firing spuriously.
model_claims.source_quote: Evaluate every rotation condition so a skipped one cannot fire spuriously

model_claims.text: With rotation=['13:00','12:00'], a file created at 06:00 and two messages logged after idle until 13:00:01 results in two log files instead of three.
model_claims.source_quote:
before — 3 files (BUG):
  file.2020-01-01_06-00-00_000000.log     'a\n'
  file.2020-01-01_13-00-01_000000.log     'b\n'    <-- spurious extra rotation
  file.log                                'c\n'
after — 2 files (correct):
  file.2020-01-01_06-00-00_000000.log     'a\n'
  file.log                                'b\nc\n'

model_claims.text: The __call__ method returns True if any rotation condition returns True, preserving the original any() semantics.
model_claims.source_quote: This keeps the documented 'any of which can trigger the rotation' contract for the return value

model_claims.text: The added test test_multiple_rotation_conditions_all_evaluated fails before the change and passes after.
model_claims.source_quote:
`test_multiple_rotation_conditions_all_evaluated` is added to `tests/test_filesink_rotation.py`.
- Fails before the change with `assert 3 == 2`; passes after.
